scope: Test fixture only; no production or art changes.
observed_failure: Original ground-loot regression stalled after check 103 when awaiting the first viewport frame after synchronous map/save reloads.
finding: Map/save reloads repopulate ambient actors after the initial isolated fixture clears them. Disabling all physics callbacks during the fixed-position GUI phase completed all 166 checks; pausing sprites, disabling only regular process callbacks, and lifecycle yields did not reliably complete.
change: Clear ambient monsters and pause player physics only during native mouse/touch GUI hit testing. Restore player physics before the existing real boss death, AUTO walking pickup, and attack-resumption checks.
coverage: All original assertions retained, plus one actual class-entry assertion. Physical manual/AUTO movement before GUI; 3 resolutions x 2 camera zooms x mouse/touch; real ranged kill/drop/walk/combat resumption after GUI.
limits: Callback traces returned from move_and_slide and actor_motion.apply. No deterministic production script loop or engine defect was proved; this change isolates the existing GUI fixture.
rendered_fixture_failure: The original ground test did not confirm the first-run class picker. OpenGL validation therefore left movement disabled and the modal intercepted pointer input (47 original assertion failures).
class_entry_change: Use the existing tests/qa_class_selection.gd helper and assert actual class selection enters gameplay before the unchanged loot tests.
